Lemma
[Kato's inequality]

Source: petersen:page-0356 Let $f=|T|$ for a tensor field $T$. At every point where $f$ is smooth, \[ df\le | abla T|. \]
Proof

↗ lem:pet-ch9-kato-inequality \sketch Where $|T|>0$, differentiating $|T|^2$ and applying Cauchy–Schwarz gives $2|T|\, d|T|=2g( abla T,T)\le 2| abla T|\, |T|$. Division by $2|T|$ proves the estimate.

□
